ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels; dark pixels dominate the central peduncle attachment and inner lobe regions, while white pixels dominate the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity central region spanning from the notch to the lateral mid-points. High-intensity distal fields on both lobes (left and right) are interrupted by high-frequency, low-intensity circular mottling and irregular focal spots, particularly concentrated at the fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 58 degrees; depth of depression is significant, bisecting the lobes cleanly.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is most pronounced on the distal edges, with smoother, lower-amplitude variations approaching the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric outward sweep with a moderately concave trailing edge near the notch, transitioning to convex curves at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast dark-on-white and white-on-dark rings (barnacle scars) located predominantly on the right fluke tip and along the upper border of the left fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned, fine linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the high-intensity surface of the left lobe, ranging from 20 to 50 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion and 'ragged' topography on the extreme distal edge of the right lobe, likely representing cumulative physical trauma or heavy colonization effects.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark 'smudge' or pigmentation bleed located at the 2 o'clock position relative to the center of the left lobe's high-intensity region.
